name: Checkerboard layers (cactus)
description: Cactus on sand in a checkerboard so no cactus touches another block horizontally (vanilla rule); a path every third row, two layers with a glass separator. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next path (+Z by 3)
Drop to the lower layer when the top is done
harvest_direction: Along X; break the upper cactus block, keep the base
build_order: Place every cactus on a checkerboard: skip each block whose neighbour (X or Z) already has a cactus.
